# Marco Pietri

> IT Strategist & AI Automation Engineer based in Florence, Italy. Specializing in enterprise automation architectures, machine learning workflows, fintech infrastructure at miPAGO, and community digital platforms (Founder of Eklisso).

Marco Pietri is an Italian technologist and IT strategist. He designs and implements distributed software architectures, predictive intelligence models, autonomous agentic workflows, and high-efficiency business automation systems.

## Core Projects & Case Studies

- [Eklisso Platform](https://marcopietri.com/eklisso/): Community digital bulletin & social engagement platform in Florence founded by Marco Pietri, featuring automated moderation pipelines, micro-services, and hyper-local community dynamics.
- [CASS — Autonomous Scraper System](https://marcopietri.com/cass/): Enterprise-grade autonomous data ingestion architecture combining headless browser pools, self-healing parsers, and intelligent deduplication.
- [Spectra Intelligence Suite](https://marcopietri.com/spectra/): Predictive AI framework and machine learning pipeline for high-dimensional data analysis, trend forecasting, and automated decision-making.
- [Certifications & Accreditations](https://marcopietri.com/certificazioni/): Official certifications spanning AI engineering, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and EASA/ENAC UAS professional drone operations.
